text:
maria: quick note: i opened a small follow-up to the offload API RFC to clarify the pin-token handshake. goal: reduce accidental long-lived pins and make retries explicit. pr: <https://go/internal/prs/allocator-offload-handshake|allocator-offload-handshake>

aj: saw it. thanks. two questions: 1) sync overhead on release, 2) semantics of try_pin after demote finishes.

maria: answers in-thread: 1) release is async by default. it returns a PinToken immediately. consumer can call `await token.done()` if they care about completion but most hot-paths should fire-and-forget. we avoid a blocking syscall in the common case.

kevin: 2) try_pin semantics: if token is still in-flight, try_pin is a fast-path that attempts to re-acquire without a remap. if demote completed, try_pin will return Err and caller must call acquire() again. that keeps state machine simple.

sarah: note: try_pin should be best-effort only. we can't guarantee a successful pin if compaction was triggered. should document race windows clearly. add a small ASCII state diagram in the API docs.

maria: added sketch in PR:
```
[acquire] -> (HANDLED)
release -> PinToken(inflight)
PinToken -> offloader: accept/demote/compact
try_pin(pin_token) -> Success (fast re-pin) | Fail (caller re-acquire)
```

tim: will we surface NUMA/gpu-affinity in the PinToken? we need that for scheduling demote jobs to correct node.

kevin: yes, PinToken includes `affinity: "gpu0, numa1"` and an optional `residency_hint_ms` (stringified int in logs). both are opaque fields on the token.

aj: telemetry req: token.id and handle.id so we can correlate traces. add metric hooks: `pin_token.handback` and `demote.failure` with tenant tag.

sarah: testing plan: - unit tests for try_pin races - microbench: 1k small-batch iterations comparing old vs new release path - NUMA matrix job to ensure no cross-node perf cliffs

maria: about fragmentation accounting: allocator will continue to own free-range bookkeeping. offloader will emit migration/demote counts and hotness maps. we add a reconcile rpc: `offloader.reconcile_alloc_snapshot(snapshot_version)` which is pull-based.

aj: reconcile should be rate-limited and snapshot incremental. please ensure snapshots are cheap (bitset / epoch id) not full range dumps.

maria: agreed. impl note: snapshot is an incremental bloom-ish summary + epoch id. offloader uses epoch to ensure monotonic application.

kevin: edge cases: if demote IO fails we mark token.status = FAILED and include `failure_reason`. fallback path: immediate make-host-resident and increment `demote.errors`. add circuit-breaker scoped by tenant.

maria: security note: tokens must be opaque and signed (hmac) when crossing process boundaries to prevent token forgery. add KMS rotation note in RFC.

offload-bot: Deploybot: feature flag `offload.handshake.v2` created; canary scheduled.

maria: i'll wait for folks to review PR; tagging @aj @kevin @sarah @tim. feel free to drop quick :eyes: or tiny comments. i'll merge after unit tests + microbench results look ok.

kevin: will add telemetry PR after this merges.

aj: i'll run the microbench and post numbers. initial expectation: <1% p50, small p99 risk.

sarah: i'll add compaction stress harness and a NUMA test job.

maria: thanks all — closing thread.
